description: This file contains functions for normalizing and parsing webhook messages and reactions related to BlueBubbles messaging, including extracting message details, attachments, reply metadata, and handling tapback reactions.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> or null if not an object.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Reads a string value from a record by key, returns undefined if not present or not a string.

methods.name: readNumber
methods.description: Reads a finite number from a record by key, returns undefined if not present or not a number.

methods.name: readBoolean
methods.description: Reads a boolean value from a record by key, returns undefined if not present or not a boolean.

methods.name: readNumberLike
methods.description: Parses a value as a finite number using parseFiniteNumber.

methods.name: extractAttachments
methods.description: Extracts attachments from a message record into an array of BlueBubblesAttachment.

methods.name: buildAttachmentPlaceholder
methods.description: Creates a placeholder string based on the types and count of attachments.

methods.name: buildMessagePlaceholder
methods.description: Builds a message placeholder string, prioritizing attachments and stickers.

methods.name: formatReplyTag
methods.description: Returns an inline reply tag like '[[reply_to:ID]]' based on message reply IDs.

methods.name: extractReplyMetadata
methods.description: Extracts reply-related metadata such as reply ID, body, and sender from a message record.

methods.name: readFirstChatRecord
methods.description: Returns the first chat record from a message's chats array.

methods.name: readParticipantEntries
methods.description: Extracts participant entries from a record, checking various keys.

methods.name: extractSenderInfo
methods.description: Extracts sender ID, name, and whether the ID was explicit from a message record.

methods.name: extractChatContext
methods.description: Extracts chat-related info such as GUID, ID, name, participants, and group status.

methods.name: normalizeParticipantEntry
methods.description: Normalizes a participant entry into a BlueBubblesParticipant object.

methods.name: normalizeParticipantList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of participant entries, removing duplicates.

methods.name: formatGroupMembers
methods.description: Formats a list of participants into a string, with optional fallback.

methods.name: resolveGroupFlagFromChatGuid
methods.description: Determines if a chat GUID indicates a group chat based on its pattern.

methods.name: extractChatIdentifierFromChatGuid
methods.description: Extracts the chat identifier part from a chat GUID.

methods.name: formatGroupAllowlistEntry
methods.description: Creates a string representation for group allowlist entries based on chat GUID, ID, or identifier.

methods.name: normalizeWebhookMessage
methods.description: Main function to normalize incoming webhook payload into a structured message object.

methods.name: normalizeWebhookReaction
methods.description: Main function to normalize incoming webhook payload into a reaction object.

methods.name: resolveTapbackContext
methods.description: Resolves tapback context including emoji and action hints from a message.

methods.name: parseTapbackText
methods.description: Parses tapback text patterns into structured reaction data.

methods.name: extractFirstEmoji
methods.description: Extracts the first emoji from a text string using regex.

methods.name: extractQuotedTapbackText
methods.description: Extracts quoted text from a string, e.g., 'Loved "hello"'.

methods.name: isTapbackAssociatedType
methods.description: Checks if a message type indicates a tapback.

methods.name: resolveTapbackActionHint
methods.description: Determines if a tapback type indicates addition or removal.
